description: This file defines the AWS SDK client for the Braket service, including method signatures for various Braket API calls and the class extending AWS client functionalities.

classes.name: BraketClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the AWS Braket service, providing methods for managing quantum computing jobs and resources.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a specific quantum computing job.

methods.name: cancelJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a specific quantum computing job.

methods.name: cancelQuantumTask
methods.description: Cancels a quantum task.

methods.name: cancelQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a quantum task.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new quantum computing job.

methods.name: createJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum computing job.

methods.name: createQuantumTask
methods.description: Creates a new quantum task.

methods.name: createQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum task.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific quantum device.

methods.name: getDeviceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a quantum device.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific quantum job.

methods.name: getJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a quantum job.

methods.name: getQuantumTask
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific quantum task.

methods.name: getQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a quantum task.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: searchDevices
methods.description: Searches for available quantum devices.

methods.name: searchDevicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for quantum devices.

methods.name: searchJobs
methods.description: Searches for quantum jobs.

methods.name: searchJobsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for quantum jobs.

methods.name: searchQuantumTasks
methods.description: Searches for quantum tasks.

methods.name: searchQuantumTasksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for quantum tasks.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
